chapter: Touring in the bus years and Jim Crow in the South
title: Sidemen who passed through the band: Geesil Minerve and Harold Bruce
summary: Fields lists players who went on to big bands, such as Geesil Minerve and Harold Bruce.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now Ernie, you had some men with your band, you supplied many of the big name bands with some men.
I did. Right now, Harold Ninerve, we called him Geesil, a nickname.
Yeah, alto sax, he's in Duke's band right now.
He also preceded me in Ray Charles' band.
I replaced him--not directly, he had been there before me, an alto sax tenor. What's his real name?
You know, I thought Geesil was a nickname.
No, I think that's really his name.

Yes, Harold Bruce. I've had some of the greats, and they always said--you know, I had that reputation about music, well, the guys always knew--I'll tell you another band that used to work on some, was Nat.
